card.name: Head nouns ending a noun phrase
card.fires_on: Responds to the last word of a multi-word noun phrase, such as tablets, meeting, room, plants or Area, just before a verb or a preposition. It also appears on some commas and partway through names.

modes.label: Final noun of a compound
modes.description: The head noun that completes a compound name or place, just before the sentence continues.
modes.example: the state brought 29 more Eastern wild turkeys to the Whitewater Wildlife Management<< Area>> in southeastern Minnesota

modes.label: Drug or product noun
modes.description: A word that follows a drug name or a drug list, such as tablets, where a verb is expected next.
modes.example: The dose of ezetimibe and simvastatin<< tablets>> should not exceed 1

modes.label: Partway through a name
modes.description: A piece inside a longer name or code, such as an enzyme name or a place name.
